description: The GitHub Actions pipeline pins deprecated action majors (checkout/setup-node/pnpm v4 where v5 exists), and prod carries dead ADMIN_USER_2/ADMIN_PASS_2 secrets left from the collapsed dual-credential auth. Bump the action majors and remove the dead secrets.
title: Clear tooling debt: bump deprecated Actions and remove dead admin secrets
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions use current majors (checkout/setup-node/pnpm v5)
The dead ADMIN_USER_2 / ADMIN_PASS_2 prod secrets are removed
CI still passes after the bump
